patches.entity_key: Possessive adjectives agree with the noun they modify
value: mon livre / ma maison / mes livres

evidence.notes: Source gives the full paradigm and the exception that mon, ton, son replace ma, ta, sa before a singular feminine noun beginning with a vowel or mute h; the items show agreement with the noun and the vowel-initial case. Low uncertainty.

patches.entity_key: Possessive pronouns replace noun + possessive adjective

evidence.notes: Source gives the pronoun paradigm with definite article, agreement with the noun replaced, and the à/de contraction exception (au mien, du mien); the items instantiate singular, plural, and contraction. Low uncertainty.

patches.entity_key: Possessive pronouns with aussi and non plus
value: ma voiture -> la mienne non plus

evidence.notes: Source gives the pattern possessive pronoun + aussi (affirmative) / + non plus (negative); the items show the feminine pronoun la mienne agreeing with voiture. Low uncertainty.

patches.entity_key: Preposition with countries: en, au, aux
